text.en: Clients consistently praise owner and stylist Farrell for his welcoming attitude, deep expertise, and accommodating demeanor. Dog owners note that he listens carefully to styling requests and provides helpful advice regarding ear care and hygiene. Many reviewers describe him as an attentive professional who makes both guardians and pets feel completely at ease upon arrival.

Reviewers frequently express satisfaction with the standard of full haircuts, bath treatments, and nail trims. Dog owners highlight that styling is carried out neatly according to breed standards, with coats looking fresh and claws handled smoothly. Multiple clients report returning regularly because their dogs look impeccably groomed and smell wonderful after each session.

Pet parents particularly appreciate how comfortably squirmy, timid, or large rescue dogs are handled throughout appointments. Several reviewers mention that dogs that normally fear groomers show no apprehension at this salon, remaining calm during claw clipping and coat trimming. Owners value the patient approach that accommodates nervous dogs with warmth and care.

q.en: Can the salon groom large breeds and dogs with anxiety?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently note that the groomer handles large breeds and anxious dogs with exceptional patience and gentle technique.

q.en: Does EZ Dog Grooming offer online booking?

a.en: Yes, clients can conveniently book grooming appointments through the shop's online booking system.

q.en: Are walk-in visits or quick nail trimming services accommodated?

a.en: Yes, several customers report walking in for quick nail trims and paw tidying without prolonged waiting times.

q.en: Does the location carry pet supplies in addition to grooming services?

a.en: Yes, the salon stocks a curated selection of dog food, treats, toys, collars, and outdoor apparel in its East Pender Street shop.
